user.job: decide how ZKC classifies each captured item into the static or dynamic track, and how it combines items into systematic models or methodology, without corrupting lifecycle signals

baseline.workflow: no classification or combination mechanism chosen; prior research fixed Postgres+pgvector as the substrate, Ollama+Instructor+LangGraph as the LLM stack, and concluded that ZKC's dual-track model, decay and attention scheduling are uncovered by any candidate
failureModes: misclassified items poison the decay and attention signals downstream
no abstention, so uncertain items are forced into a track
combination degrades into summarisation instead of producing methodology
combined output has no provenance, so it cannot be reused or verified

targetOutcome: select the mechanisms for dual-track routing and for the combination operator, and state explicitly which semantics ZKC must own
goals: compare candidates on T0.1 classification/routing and T3.2 combination synthesis
determine whether calibrated abstention and provenance are available
nonGoals: do not implement the operators in this step
do not adopt a maintenance-mode project as a dependency

constraints.statement: the router must be able to abstain rather than force a choice
local/offline operation preferred for personal data
must fit the already-chosen Postgres + pgvector substrate
combined output must cite its sources
findings pinned to a sealed ledger snapshot on 2026-10-29

assumptions: stars and topicMatch are discovery signals, not capability scores
a labelled sample set can be produced to calibrate the router
the combination operator can be expressed as a program rather than a single prompt
decisionScope: mechanism selection for ZKC's classification and combination operators

options.name: calibrated semantic routing with abstention for T0.1
adopt GraphRAG or LightRAG as the knowledge layer wholesale
